stealth-detection.source: The Awakened discipline contributes its shipped rank-scaled detection modifier to stat 204.
stealth-detection.runtime: Stealth.AwarenessOf adds live 204 to the observer creation value. Unloading Awakened removes the contribution without removing the observer.
stealth-detection.test: StarterSpyVisibilityBatchMode compares the same observer and location before and after unloading Awakened. Native PR530 measured Awareness 5, then 1, then 5 again without Detection loaded. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/530

damage.source: GOB 36 stores fixed viral damage 4 and a 2 m target-centred area.
damage.runtime: The landed viral hit is scaled by the active caster and each primary or secondary recipient supplies its own resistance stat.
damage.test: StarterViralResistanceBatchMode and native PR532 checked one cast against same-level targets. It hit the neutral primary for 4 and the +75 Viral Resistance secondary for 2. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/532

stats.source: GOB 45 supplies learned-rank modifiers for Max IS, IS regeneration, Evade Interlock Bonus and Concentration Bonus.
stats.runtime: AbilityBuffs.RefreshVitals consumes the max bonus; regeneration consumes the linked rate; CombatInsightEngagement consumes 1049 in its modeled shield rule; concentration is linked to 564.
stats.test: HackerBatchBParityTests.ExecuteProgram45ChangesTheActualInnerStrengthMaximumAndRegen, CombatInsightEngagementTests.ExecuteProgramOnlyChangesEntryWhileItsBonusAndTheShieldAreActive, and native PR521/528/529 confirm rank-50 +10/+10/+5/+5 use. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/528 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/529

consumer.source: The two previously untracked combat consumers are Evade Interlock Bonus 1049 and the shipped Concentration Bonus link 564→1090.
consumer.runtime: The existing modeled entry rule applies 1049 once with an active shield. Cast interruption uses AbilityStats.Influence on 564 with the linked bonus.
consumer.test: Native PR529 observes evade 115 while loaded, 110 unloaded, then ordinary entry with the shield off. Native PR521 verifies that Execute Program supplies the 5-point baseline with Concentration 628 unloaded. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/529 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/521

damage.source: GOB 57 stores an instant typed viral modifier with fixed base 8.
damage.runtime: StarterHackerViralBase supplies the fixed value for incomplete legacy endpoints. TypedAbilityResistance applies the matched recipient modifier once on landing.
damage.test: StarterViralResistanceBatchMode and native PR532 record 8 on a neutral same-level NPC and 4 on +75 Viral Resistance. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/532

stealth-detection.source: Shipped Sneak detection uses the observer awareness, caster Stealth, range and a periodic random contest.
stealth-detection.runtime: The live player contest reads both loaded observer modifiers and active caster Stealth, and a reveal restores the hidden view.
stealth-detection.test: StarterSpyVisibilityBatchMode verifies deletion and restoration with four loaded-state combinations. Native PR530 observed the same Sneak route at SA/SL 5/15, 10/15, 1/15 and 5/23. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/530

notes.PR527: Stock 149 worked from rest and was blocked in interlock. 152 opened from Sneak and sent 30/15 s reuse. 146 cast for 2 s, applied the thrown DOT, and sent 20/3 s reuse. PR531 already closes the Backsweep native family. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/527
notes.PR528: The cap changes 220→200→220 with Execute Program; +8 baseline versus +8/+9 loaded regeneration is distinct from 217 costing 40 and 184 costing 25 on activation and first drain. PR531 already closes the Execute Program native family. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/528
notes.PR529: 45 adds five points to the modeled live 217 entry score. At the same force 110, entry refuses at 115 and admits at 110 after unloading. Normal entry after shield-off is admitted and the own timer is 30 s. The retail shield rules remain open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/529
notes.PR530: The ordinary Sneak contest reads loaded 2 and 298; removing both restores base Awareness 1. The 298 activation geometry and NPC callback are independent checks. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/530
notes.PR532: The same-level two-target comparison supplied 33: 24/13, 36: 4/2 in one splash, and 57: 8/4 under the existing typed-resistance model. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/532
